end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem v3_gen_006 (a b c : ℝ) (h1 : a > 0) (h2 : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by

  have h3 : a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 + c - b^2 / (4 * a) := by
    rw [mul_add, add_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left]

    rw [h1, zero_lt_one]

    rw [h2, zero_lt_sub]
    exact div_pos h1 (by linarith)
  exact add_pos h4 h5
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.v3_gen_006 = Nl2LeanCandidate.v3_gen_006 := by
